title: Bytes, Letters and the Dot: What a QString Length Counts, Where Text Goes Wrong on the Wire, and the Decimal Point a Locale Moves
fallback: This lesson is about how QString holds text and how Qt turns numbers into text, so it needs Qt. Lesson 03-15 asks the same questions of numbers and text without Qt, and lesson 01-05 of strings. Without Qt, do those and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: text decoded from bytes with a flag for bad input, letters counted as letters, and numbers read and written the same way on every machine
